<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>BBK — Made with better moments in mind</title>
<meta name="description" content="At Empório Bolos, we bake more than cakes — we create sweet moments for life's special occasions.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600&family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,400;9..144,500;9..144,600&family=Nothing+You+Could+Do&family=Dancing+Script:wght@500;600&family=Playfair+Display:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#ffffff;
    --ink:#262626;
    --ink-soft:#5b5b5b;
    --wine:#6b1a2c;
    --serif:"Fraunces", Georgia, serif;
    --sans:"DM Sans", system-ui, sans-serif;
    --script:"Nothing You Could Do", cursive;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}

  /* 1rem = 10px na largura de referência (1037px); escala junto com a tela no desktop */
  html{font-size:clamp(7px, calc(100vw / 103.7), 18px);scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:7rem}
  body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--sans);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden}
  body.lock{overflow:hidden}
  a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
  button{font:inherit;color:inherit;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer}
  img{max-width:100%}
  [hidden]{display:none !important}
  :focus-visible{outline:2px solid #6b1a2c;outline-offset:2px}

  /* =====================================================
     HEADER
     ===================================================== */
  .site-header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;height:7rem;transition:background .25s,box-shadow .25s}
  .site-header.scrolled{background:rgba(255,255,255,.94);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(30,30,30,.08)}
  .header-inner{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;height:100%;padding:0 6.5rem 0 5.2rem}

  .logo{width:12.6rem;margin-top:.3rem;flex:none;line-height:0}
  .logo img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}

  .nav{margin-left:10.4rem;height:5.4rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3.3rem}
  .nav a{font-size:1.2rem;color:#2b2b2b;white-space:nowrap;transition:opacity .2s}
  .nav a:hover{opacity:.6}

  .tools{margin-left:auto;height:5.4rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2.5rem}
  .icon-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative}
  .cart-btn i{position:absolute;right:-1.5rem;top:-1.1rem;min-width:1.3rem;height:1.3rem;padding:0 .3rem;border-radius:.7rem;background:var(--wine);color:#fff;font:normal 500 .7rem/1.3rem var(--sans);text-align:center;transition:transform .2s}
  .cart-btn.bump i{transform:scale(1.35)}
  .btn-nav{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:11.9rem;height:3.4rem;border-radius:.7rem;background:var(--wine);color:#fff;font-size:1.2rem;margin-left:1.6rem;transition:background .2s}
  .btn-nav:hover{background:#561423}
  .menu-btn{display:none}

  .searchbar{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:100%;padding:1rem 5.2rem 1.4rem;background:rgba(255,255,255,.98);box-shadow:0 1.2rem 2.4rem rgba(30,30,30,.08)}
  .searchbar input{width:100%;max-width:44rem;display:block;margin-left:auto;height:4rem;border:1px solid #dcdcdc;border-radius:.8rem;background:#fff;padding:0 1.4rem;font:inherit;font-size:1.4rem;color:var(--ink)}

  /* =====================================================
     HERO
     ===================================================== */
  .hero{position:relative;height:55.1rem;margin-top:-7rem;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(100deg,#ffffff 0%,#fafafa 45%,#f3f3f3 100%)}
  .hero-content{position:relative;z-index:4;padding:11.1rem 0 0 5.2rem;width:46rem}
  .eyebrow{font-size:1.1rem;letter-spacing:.26em;color:var(--ink-soft);text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.3rem}
  h1{margin-top:1.3rem;font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:500;font-size:6rem;line-height:5.4rem;letter-spacing:-.025em;color:var(--ink);font-variation-settings:"opsz" 144}
  .lead{margin-top:.9rem;font-size:1.6rem;line-height:2.2rem;color:var(--ink-soft)}
  .actions{margin-top:2.4rem;display:flex;gap:1.3rem}
  .btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.8rem;height:4.1rem;border-radius:.8rem;font-size:1.35rem;white-space:nowrap;transition:background .2s,transform .15s}
  .btn:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
  .btn-primary{width:15.7rem;background:var(--wine);color:#fff}
  .btn-primary:hover{background:#561423}
  .btn-outline{width:16rem;border:1px solid #cfcfcf;background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);color:var(--ink)}
  .btn-outline:hover{background:#fff}
  .btn svg{width:1.4rem;height:1.4rem}

  .features{margin-top:3.7rem;display:flex}
  .feature{width:13.05rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.9rem}
  .feature svg{width:2.6rem;height:2.6rem;flex:none}
  .feature span{font-size:1.15rem;line-height:1.6rem;color:var(--ink-soft)}

  .media{position:absolute;left:41rem;top:0;right:0;height:100%;z-index:1}
  .media-bg{
    position:absolute;inset:0;margin:0;
    -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to right,transparent 0,#000 12%);
            mask-image:linear-gradient(to right,transparent 0,#000 12%);
  }
  /* >>> Quando a imagem chegar: colocar <img src="..." alt="..."> dentro de .media-bg
         e remover o .media-slot <<< */
  .media-bg img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 88%;display:block}
  .media-slot{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f3f3f3 0%,#e8e8e8 100%);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
  .media-slot::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:4rem 4rem 4rem 12rem;border:1.5px dashed #c8c8c8;border-radius:2rem}
  .media-slot span{position:relative;font-size:1.2rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#9a9a9a;text-align:center;line-height:1.8rem;padding-left:8rem}

  .script{position:absolute;z-index:3;font-family:var(--script);pointer-events:none}
  .script-top{left:calc(100% - 21.3rem);top:10.2rem;font-size:2.5rem;line-height:2.6rem;color:#b8b8b8;transform:rotate(-22deg);transform-origin:left top}
  .script-bottom{left:calc(100% - 9.3rem);top:44.6rem;font-size:2.4rem;line-height:2.55rem;color:#3a3a3a;transform:rotate(-14deg);transform-origin:left top}

  .hero-card{
    position:absolute;left:calc(100% - 28.9rem);top:30.3rem;width:25.7rem;height:9.4rem;z-index:4;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.96);border-radius:.9rem;box-shadow:0 1.2rem 3rem rgba(30,30,30,.14);
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1.3rem;padding:0 1.2rem 0 1.3rem;transition:transform .25s;
  }
  .hero-card:hover{transform:translateY(-.3rem)}
  .card-thumb{width:7rem;height:7rem;border-radius:.7rem;flex:none;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#eeeeee,#dddddd)}
  /* >>> Miniatura: <img src="..."> dentro de .card-thumb <<< */
  .card-thumb img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;border-radius:.7rem;display:block}
  .card-text{flex:1;min-width:0}
  .card-text h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:500;font-size:1.35rem;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.6rem}
  .card-text p{margin-top:.5rem;font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--ink-soft);line-height:1.3rem}
  .rating{margin-top:.8rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;font-size:1rem;color:var(--ink-soft)}
  .stars{display:flex;gap:.15rem}
  .stars svg{width:.95rem;height:.95rem;fill:#666666}
  .go{width:2.3rem;height:2.3rem;border-radius:50%;background:var(--wine);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:none;align-self:flex-end;margin-bottom:1.4rem}
  .go svg{width:1.1rem;height:1.1rem}

  /* =====================================================
     SIGNATURE
     ===================================================== */
  .signature{position:relative;background:#f4f4f4;padding:1.9rem 0 3.8rem}
  .signature h2{text-align:center;font-family:"Dancing Script",cursive;font-weight:500;font-size:5.6rem;line-height:5.6rem;color:#262626;letter-spacing:.01em}
  .sig-grid{width:73.2rem;margin:3rem auto 0;display:flex;gap:1.5rem;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scrollbar-width:none}
  .sig-grid::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
  .sig-item{width:23.4rem;flex:none;text-align:center;scroll-snap-align:start}
  .sig-img{position:relative;height:30.4rem;margin:0;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#ececec 0%,#dedede 100%);overflow:hidden}
  /* >>> Imagem: <img src="..." alt="..."> dentro de .sig-img e remover o .sig-slot <<< */
  .sig-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
  .slot{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center}
  .slot::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:1.6rem;border:1.5px dashed #bdbdbd;border-radius:.4rem}
  .slot span{position:relative;font-size:1.1rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#999999;line-height:1.7rem}
  .sig-item h3{margin-top:1.5rem;font-family:"Playfair Display",Georgia,serif;font-weight:500;font-size:2.3rem;line-height:3rem;color:#262626}
  .sig-item p{margin-top:.6rem;padding:0 .8rem;font-size:1.1rem;line-height:1.6rem;color:#777777}
  .sig-item p span{display:block}
  .sig-item p span+span{margin-top:.2rem}
  .sig-item a{display:inline-block;margin-top:.8rem;font-size:1.05rem;line-height:1.4rem;color:#6b1a2c;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:.2rem}
  .sig-arrow{position:absolute;top:24.7rem;width:2.4rem;height:2.4rem;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
  .sig-arrow svg{width:1.6rem;height:1.6rem}
  .sig-prev{left:7.2rem}
  .sig-next{right:7.4rem}

  /* =====================================================
     CATÁLOGO
     ===================================================== */
  .catalog{background:#ffffff;padding:3.2rem 0 9rem}
  .catalog-title{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.9rem;font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#262626;line-height:1.6rem}
  .catalog-title svg{width:1.2rem;height:1.2rem}
  .products{width:73.2rem;margin:3.2rem auto 0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1.9rem 1.5rem}
  .product{background:#fff;border-radius:1.2rem;box-shadow:0 .8rem 2.2rem rgba(30,30,30,.09);overflow:hidden;text-align:center;transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s}
  .product:hover{transform:translateY(-.4rem);box-shadow:0 1.4rem 3rem rgba(30,30,30,.14)}
  .product-img{position:relative;height:19rem;margin:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f4eaec 0%,#ead5da 100%)}
  .product:nth-child(3n+2) .product-img{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f1f1f1 0%,#e4e4e4 100%)}
  .product:nth-child(3n) .product-img{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f6ecee 0%,#e9d9dd 100%)}
  /* >>> Foto do produto: campo "image" (e "pos" para o enquadramento) no array PRODUCTS, no script, no fim do arquivo <<< */
  .product-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
  .product .slot::before{border-color:rgba(107,26,44,.35);inset:1.2rem}
  .product .slot span{color:#9a7f85;font-size:.95rem}
  .product-body{padding:1.2rem 1rem 1.7rem}
  .product h3{font-family:"Playfair Display",Georgia,serif;font-weight:500;font-size:2.1rem;line-height:2.4rem;color:#262626}
  .product p{margin-top:.1rem;font-size:1.15rem;line-height:1.6rem;color:#7a7a7a}
  .add{margin-top:1.9rem;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:3.2rem;min-width:10.2rem;padding:0 1.4rem;border-radius:1.6rem;background:#ecd0d6;color:#2b2b2b;font-size:1rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;transition:filter .2s,transform .15s}
  .product:nth-child(3n+2) .add{background:#e9e9e9}
  .product:nth-child(3n) .add{background:#f5e3e6}
  .add:hover{filter:brightness(.96)}
  .add:active{transform:scale(.97)}
  .add.done{background:var(--wine) !important;color:#fff}
  .no-results{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;padding:4rem 0;font-size:1.5rem;color:var(--ink-soft)}

  /* =====================================================
     CARRINHO (gaveta)
     ===================================================== */
  .overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:90;background:rgba(20,20,20,.45);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
  .overlay.show{opacity:1}
  .drawer{position:fixed;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:100;width:42rem;max-width:100%;background:#ffffff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:-1.6rem 0 4rem rgba(20,20,20,.18);transform:translateX(100%);visibility:hidden;transition:transform .32s ease,visibility 0s .32s}
  .drawer.open{transform:none;visibility:visible;transition:transform .32s ease}
  .drawer-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:2rem 2.2rem;border-bottom:1px solid #e8e8e8}
  .drawer-head h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:500;font-size:2.4rem;color:var(--ink)}
  .drawer-head button{width:3.4rem;height:3.4rem;border-radius:50%;font-size:2.4rem;line-height:1;color:var(--ink-soft)}
  .drawer-head button:hover{background:#f0f0f0}
  .drawer-body{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:1rem 2.2rem}
  .empty{padding:5rem 0;text-align:center;color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:1.5rem;line-height:2.2rem}
  .empty a{display:inline-block;margin-top:1.4rem;color:var(--wine);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:.3rem}
  .line{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1.2rem;padding:1.4rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid #ececec}
  .line-info{flex:1;min-width:0}
  .line-name{font-family:"Playfair Display",Georgia,serif;font-size:1.7rem;line-height:2.2rem;color:var(--ink)}
  .line-desc{margin-top:.2rem;font-size:1.2rem;color:#7a7a7a}
  .qty{display:flex;align-items:center;border:1px solid #dcdcdc;border-radius:2rem;background:#fff}
  .qty button{width:3rem;height:3rem;font-size:1.7rem;color:var(--ink)}
  .qty span{min-width:2.2rem;text-align:center;font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:500}
  .remove{width:3rem;height:3rem;border-radius:50%;color:#999999;font-size:1.8rem;line-height:1}
  .remove:hover{background:#f0f0f0;color:var(--wine)}
  .drawer-foot{padding:1.8rem 2.2rem 2.2rem;border-top:1px solid #e8e8e8;background:#ffffff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1rem}
  .drawer-foot input,.drawer-foot textarea{width:100%;border:1px solid #dcdcdc;border-radius:.8rem;background:#fff;padding:1.1rem 1.3rem;font:inherit;font-size:1.4rem;color:var(--ink);resize:none}
  .wa-btn{width:100%;height:4.8rem;font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:500}
  .wa-btn svg{width:2rem;height:2rem}
  .wa-btn:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
  .hint{text-align:center;font-size:1.15rem;color:#7a7a7a}

  .toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:3rem;z-index:120;transform:translate(-50%,2rem);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;background:var(--wine);color:#fff;padding:1.2rem 2.2rem;border-radius:3rem;font-size:1.35rem;box-shadow:0 1rem 2.6rem rgba(20,20,20,.28);transition:opacity .25s,transform .25s;white-space:nowrap}
  .toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}

  /* =====================================================
     RODAPÉ
     ===================================================== */
  .site-footer{background:var(--wine);color:rgba(255,255,255,.86);font-size:1.3rem;line-height:2rem}
  .footer-main{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.35fr .8fr 1.15fr 1.15fr;gap:4rem;padding:6.4rem 5.2rem 5rem}
  .footer-logo{display:inline-block;width:17rem;padding:.9rem;border-radius:1.2rem;background:#fff;line-height:0;box-shadow:0 1rem 2.4rem rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
  .footer-logo img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
  .footer-about{margin-top:2rem;max-width:30rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.8)}
  .footer-col h3{font-family:"Playfair Display",Georgia,serif;font-weight:500;font-size:1.9rem;line-height:2.4rem;color:#fff;margin-bottom:1.8rem}
  .footer-col ul{list-style:none}
  .footer-col li+li{margin-top:1rem}
  .footer-col a{transition:color .2s,opacity .2s}
  .footer-col a:hover{color:#fff;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:.3rem}
  .info{display:flex;gap:1.1rem;align-items:flex-start}
  .info svg{width:1.8rem;height:1.8rem;flex:none;margin-top:.1rem;stroke:#fff}
  .info+.info{margin-top:1.4rem}
  .footer-cta{margin-top:2.2rem;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.9rem;height:4.4rem;padding:0 2.2rem;border-radius:.8rem;background:#fff;color:var(--wine);font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:600;transition:transform .15s,background .2s}
  .footer-cta:hover{background:#f4f4f4;color:var(--wine) !important;text-decoration:none !important}
  .footer-cta:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
  .footer-cta svg{width:1.8rem;height:1.8rem;fill:var(--wine)}
  .footer-bottom{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);padding:2rem 5.2rem 2.4rem;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:2rem;font-size:1.15rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7)}

  /* =====================================================
     TABLET / MOBILE
     ===================================================== */
  @media (max-width:980px){
    html{font-size:10px;scroll-padding-top:7rem}
    .site-header{height:6.4rem}
    .header-inner{padding:0 1.8rem;align-items:center}
    .logo{margin-top:0;width:11rem}
    .tools{height:auto;gap:1.8rem}
    .btn-nav{display:none}
    .menu-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
    .cart-btn i{right:-1.1rem}
    .nav{position:fixed;top:6.4rem;left:0;right:0;z-index:49;margin:0;height:auto;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:0;padding:.6rem 2rem 1.6rem;background:#ffffff;box-shadow:0 1.4rem 2.4rem rgba(30,30,30,.1);transform:translateY(-130%);visibility:hidden;transition:transform .3s,visibility 0s .3s}
    .nav.open{transform:none;visibility:visible;transition:transform .3s}
    .nav a{font-size:1.7rem;padding:1.3rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid #f0f0f0}
    .searchbar{padding:1rem 1.8rem 1.4rem}
    .searchbar input{max-width:none}

    .hero{height:auto;margin-top:-6.4rem;padding-bottom:3rem}
    .hero-content{width:auto;padding:10rem 2rem 0}
    h1{font-size:5.2rem;line-height:4.9rem}
    .lead{font-size:1.6rem;line-height:2.3rem}
    .actions{flex-wrap:wrap}
    .features{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:1.6rem 0}
    .feature{width:auto;margin-right:2.4rem}
    .media{position:relative;left:auto;right:auto;height:38rem;margin-top:3rem}
    .media-bg{-webkit-mask-image:none;mask-image:none}
    .media-slot::before{inset:2rem}
    .media-slot span{padding-left:0}
    .script-top{left:auto;right:2rem;top:2rem}
    .script-bottom{display:none}
    .hero-card{left:auto;right:1.6rem;top:auto;bottom:1.6rem;width:min(28rem,calc(100% - 3.2rem));height:9.4rem}

    .signature{padding:2.4rem 0 4rem}
    .signature h2{font-size:4.2rem;line-height:5rem;padding:0 1.6rem}
    .sig-grid{width:auto;margin:2.4rem 0 0;padding:0 2rem;gap:1.2rem}
    .sig-item{width:24rem}
    .sig-img{height:30rem}
    .sig-item p{font-size:1.25rem;line-height:1.8rem}
    .sig-item a{font-size:1.2rem}
    .sig-arrow{display:none}

    .catalog{padding:3.6rem 0 8rem}
    .products{width:auto;margin:2.8rem 0 0;padding:0 1.6rem;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:1.4rem}
    .product-img{height:19rem}
    .product h3{font-size:1.9rem}
    .add{min-width:0;width:100%;font-size:1.05rem}
    .toast{bottom:2rem}
  }
  @media (max-width:480px){
    h1{font-size:4.4rem;line-height:4.2rem}
    .products{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1rem;padding:0 1.2rem}
    .product-img{height:15rem}
    .product h3{font-size:1.6rem;line-height:2rem}
    .product p{font-size:1.1rem}
    .product-body{padding:1rem .8rem 1.3rem}
    .add{margin-top:1.2rem}
  }
  @media (max-width:980px){
    .site-footer{font-size:1.4rem;line-height:2.2rem}
    .footer-main{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:3.6rem 2.4rem;padding:4.8rem 2rem 3.6rem}
    .footer-brand{grid-column:1/-1}
    .footer-bottom{padding:1.8rem 2rem 2.4rem;flex-direction:column;gap:.4rem;font-size:1.2rem}
  }
  @media (max-width:520px){
    .footer-main{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none !important;scroll-behavior:auto !important}}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- ================= HEADER ================= -->
<header class="site-header" id="top">
  <div class="header-inner">

      <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Empório Bolos doceria" width="760" height="383">
    </a>

    <nav class="nav" id="nav" aria-label="Principal">
      <a href="#catalog">Cakes</a>
      <a href="#" data-wa-custom target="_blank" rel="noopener">Custom Orders</a>
      <a href="#">About</a>
      <a href="#">Our Story</a>
      <a href="#">Blog</a>
    </nav>

    <div class="tools">
      <button class="icon-btn" id="searchBtn" type="button" aria-label="Search cakes" aria-expanded="false">
        <svg width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#2b2b2b" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="M20 20l-4-4"/></svg>
      </button>
      <button class="icon-btn cart-btn" id="cartBtn" type="button" aria-label="Open cart">
        <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#2b2b2b" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M2 3h3l2.2 11.2a1.5 1.5 0 0 0 1.5 1.2h8.6a1.5 1.5 0 0 0 1.5-1.1L20.5 7H6"/><circle cx="9.5" cy="20" r="1.2"/><circle cx="17" cy="20" r="1.2"/></svg>
        <i id="cartCount">0</i>
      </button>
      <a href="#catalog" class="btn-nav">Order a Cake</a>
      <button class="icon-btn menu-btn" id="menuBtn" type="button" aria-label="Menu" aria-expanded="false">
        <svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#2b2b2b" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M4 7h16M4 12h16M4 17h16"/></svg>
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="searchbar" id="searchbar" hidden>
    <input id="searchInput" type="search" placeholder="Search our cakes…" aria-label="Search our cakes" autocomplete="off">
  </div>
</header>

    <div class="actions">

        <span>Made<br>with Love</span>

      <div class="feature">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 32 32" fill="none" stroke="#2b2b2b" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 8h15v13H3zM18 12h6l4 4.5V21H18"/><circle cx="9" cy="22.5" r="2.3" fill="#ffffff"/><circle cx="23" cy="22.5" r="2.3" fill="#ffffff"/></svg>

    <div class="script script-top" aria-hidden="true">Sweet<br>Moments<br>Always ♡</div>

    <a href="#catalog" class="hero-card" aria-label="Classic Chocolate — see our cakes">
      <div class="card-thumb"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Bolo Classic Chocolate com raspas de chocolate, coco e cereja" width="320" height="320"></div>
      <div class="card-text">
        <h3>Classic Chocolate</h3>
        <p>Rich. Decadent. Timeless.</p>
        <div class="rating">
          <span class="stars" aria-hidden="true">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 2l2.9 6.6 7.1.6-5.4 4.7 1.7 7-6.3-3.8-6.3 3.8 1.7-7L2 9.2l7.1-.6z"/></svg>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 2l2.9 6.6 7.1.6-5.4 4.7 1.7 7-6.3-3.8-6.3 3.8 1.7-7L2 9.2l7.1-.6z"/></svg>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 2l2.9 6.6 7.1.6-5.4 4.7 1.7 7-6.3-3.8-6.3 3.8 1.7-7L2 9.2l7.1-.6z"/></svg>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 2l2.9 6.6 7.1.6-5.4 4.7 1.7 7-6.3-3.8-6.3 3.8 1.7-7L2 9.2l7.1-.6z"/></svg>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 2l2.9 6.6 7.1.6-5.4 4.7 1.7 7-6.3-3.8-6.3 3.8 1.7-7L2 9.2l7.1-.6z"/></svg>

          4.9 (120+)

</section>

<!-- ================= CARRINHO ================= -->
<div class="overlay" id="overlay" hidden></div>
<aside class="drawer" id="drawer" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Your order" aria-hidden="true">
  <div class="drawer-head">
    <h2>Your order</h2>
    <button type="button" id="closeCart" aria-label="Close cart">×</button>
  </div>
  <div class="drawer-body" id="cartItems"></div>
  <div class="drawer-foot">
    <input id="custName" type="text" placeholder="Your name" autocomplete="name">
    <textarea id="custNotes" rows="2" placeholder="Pick-up/delivery date, message on the cake, notes…"></textarea>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary wa-btn" id="sendWa" disabled>
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12.04 2a9.9 9.9 0 0 0-8.5 14.9L2 22l5.25-1.38A9.9 9.9 0 1 0 12.04 2Zm0 18.1a8.2 8.2 0 0 1-4.2-1.15l-.3-.18-3.1.82.83-3.03-.2-.31a8.2 8.2 0 1 1 7 3.85Zm4.5-6.1c-.25-.12-1.46-.72-1.69-.8-.23-.09-.39-.12-.56.12s-.64.8-.78.97c-.14.16-.29.18-.54.06a6.7 6.7 0 0 1-3.3-2.9c-.25-.43.25-.4.72-1.33.08-.16.04-.3-.02-.42-.06-.12-.56-1.34-.76-1.84-.2-.48-.4-.41-.56-.42h-.47a.9.9 0 0 0-.65.3 2.7 2.7 0 0 0-.85 2c0 1.18.86 2.32.98 2.48.12.16 1.7 2.6 4.1 3.64 1.52.66 2.12.72 2.88.6.46-.07 1.46-.6 1.66-1.17.2-.58.2-1.07.14-1.17-.06-.1-.23-.16-.48-.28Z"/></svg>
      Send order via WhatsApp
    </button>
    <p class="hint">Prices and availability are confirmed with you on WhatsApp.</p>
  </div>
</aside>

<div class="toast" id="toast" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  /* ============ CONFIGURAÇÃO ============ */
  // WhatsApp que recebe os pedidos (código do país + DDD + número, só dígitos)
  var WHATSAPP = "551933053500";

  // Produtos do catálogo. Para colocar a foto: preencher "image" com o caminho/URL.
  var PRODUCTS = [
    { id: "whipped-cream-cake", name: "Whipped Cream Cake", desc: "Fresh cream with a glossy green topping and cherries", image: "data:image/jpeg;base64,", pos: "50% 52%" },
    { id: "chocolate-cream-cake", name: "Chocolate & Cream Cake", desc: "Chocolate shavings, white cream and cherries", image: "data:image/jpeg;base64,", pos: "50% 68%" },
    { id: "chocolate-shavings-cake", name: "Chocolate Shavings Cake", desc: "Chocolate shavings, strawberry and a bonbon", image: "data:image/jpeg;base64,", pos: "50% 62%" },
    { id: "chocolate-coconut-cake", name: "Chocolate Coconut Cake", desc: "Chocolate frosting, coconut flakes and a cherry", image: "data:image/jpeg;base64,", pos: "50% 42%" },
    { id: "two-tone-strawberry-cake", name: "Two-Tone Strawberry Cake", desc: "Chocolate and white cream with fresh strawberries", image: "data:image/jpeg;base64,", pos: "50% 53%" },
    { id: "strawberry-choco-cake", name: "Strawberry Choco Cake", desc: "Milk and white chocolate shavings, strawberries", image: "data:image/jpeg;base64,", pos: "50% 50%" }
  ];

  /* ============ UTIL ============ */
  var $ = function (s, r) { return (r || document).querySelector(s); };
  var esc = function (s) {
    return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
      return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c];
    });
  };
  var byId = {};
  PRODUCTS.forEach(function (p) { byId[p.id] = p; });

  /* ============ ESTADO DO CARRINHO ============ */
  var KEY = "bbk-cart";
  var cart = {};
  try {
    var saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || "{}");
    Object.keys(saved).forEach(function (id) {
      var q = parseInt(saved[id], 10);
      if (byId[id] && q > 0) cart[id] = Math.min(q, 99);
    });
  } catch (e) {}
  function persist() { try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(cart)); } catch (e) {} }
  function totalQty() { return Object.keys(cart).reduce(function (s, id) { return s + cart[id]; }, 0); }

  /* ============ CATÁLOGO ============ */
  var grid = $("#products");
  grid.innerHTML = PRODUCTS.map(function (p) {
    var media = p.image
      ? '<img src="' + esc(p.image) + '" alt="' + esc(p.name) + '" loading="lazy"' + (p.pos ? ' style="object-position:' + esc(p.pos) + '"' : '') + '>'
      : '<div class="slot"><span>Espaço reservado<br>para a imagem</span></div>';
    return '<article class="product" data-search="' + esc((p.name + " " + p.desc).toLowerCase()) + '">' +
      '<figure class="product-img">' + media + '</figure>' +
      '<div class="product-body">' +
        '<h3>' + esc(p.name) + '</h3>' +
        '<p>' + esc(p.desc) + '</p>' +
        '<button type="button" class="add" data-add="' + esc(p.id) + '">Add to cart</button>' +
      '</div></article>';
  }).join("") + '<p class="no-results" id="noResults" hidden>No cakes found.</p>';

  /* ============ CARRINHO — RENDER ============ */
  var drawer = $("#drawer"), overlay = $("#overlay"), cartItems = $("#cartItems");
  var countEl = $("#cartCount"), cartBtn = $("#cartBtn"), sendBtn = $("#sendWa");

  function renderCart() {
    var ids = Object.keys(cart);
    countEl.textContent = totalQty();
    sendBtn.disabled = ids.length === 0;
    if (!ids.length) {
      cartItems.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">Your cart is empty.<br>Pick a cake you love and add it to your order.<br><a href="#catalog" data-close>Browse our cakes</a></div>';
      return;
    }
    cartItems.innerHTML = ids.map(function (id) {
      var p = byId[id];
      return '<div class="line" data-id="' + esc(id) + '">' +
        '<div class="line-info"><div class="line-name">' + esc(p.name) + '</div><div class="line-desc">' + esc(p.desc) + '</div></div>' +
        '<div class="qty"><button type="button" data-act="dec" aria-label="Decrease">−</button><span>' + cart[id] + '</span><button type="button" data-act="inc" aria-label="Increase">+</button></div>' +
        '<button type="button" class="remove" data-act="rm" aria-label="Remove ' + esc(p.name) + '">×</button>' +
      '</div>';
    }).join("");
  }

  /* ============ ABRIR / FECHAR ============ */
  var lastFocus = null;
  function openCart() {
    lastFocus = document.activeElement;
    overlay.hidden = false;
    requestAnimationFrame(function () { overlay.classList.add("show"); });
    drawer.classList.add("open");
    drawer.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
    document.body.classList.add("lock");
    $("#closeCart").focus();
  }
  function closeCart() {
    overlay.classList.remove("show");
    drawer.classList.remove("open");
    drawer.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    document.body.classList.remove("lock");
    setTimeout(function () { if (!drawer.classList.contains("open")) overlay.hidden = true; }, 300);
    if (lastFocus && lastFocus.focus) lastFocus.focus();
  }

  /* ============ TOAST ============ */
  var toast = $("#toast"), toastTimer;
  function showToast(msg) {
    toast.textContent = msg;
    toast.classList.add("show");
    clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = setTimeout(function () { toast.classList.remove("show"); }, 1800);
  }

  /* ============ AÇÕES ============ */
  function addToCart(id, btn) {
    cart[id] = Math.min((cart[id] || 0) + 1, 99);
    persist(); renderCart();
    cartBtn.classList.add("bump");
    setTimeout(function () { cartBtn.classList.remove("bump"); }, 220);
    showToast(byId[id].name + " added to cart");
    if (btn) {
      var old = btn.textContent;
      btn.textContent = "Added ✓";
      btn.classList.add("done");
      setTimeout(function () { btn.textContent = old; btn.classList.remove("done"); }, 1200);
    }
  }

  document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var add = e.target.closest("[data-add]");
    if (add) { addToCart(add.getAttribute("data-add"), add); return; }

    var act = e.target.closest("[data-act]");
    if (act) {
      var id = act.closest(".line").getAttribute("data-id");
      var a = act.getAttribute("data-act");
      if (a === "inc") cart[id] = Math.min(cart[id] + 1, 99);
      if (a === "dec") { cart[id] -= 1; if (cart[id] <= 0) delete cart[id]; }
      if (a === "rm") delete cart[id];
      persist(); renderCart();
      return;
    }
    if (e.target.closest("[data-close]")) closeCart();
  });

  cartBtn.addEventListener("click", openCart);
  $("#closeCart").addEventListener("click", closeCart);
  overlay.addEventListener("click", closeCart);

  /* ============ WHATSAPP ============ */
  function waUrl(text) { return "https://wa.me/" + WHATSAPP + "?text=" + encodeURIComponent(text); }

  sendBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
    var ids = Object.keys(cart);
    if (!ids.length) return;
    var name = $("#custName").value.trim();
    var notes = $("#custNotes").value.trim();
    var lines = ["Olá! Gostaria de fazer o seguinte pedido:", ""];
    ids.forEach(function (id) { lines.push("• " + cart[id] + "x " + byId[id].name); });
    lines.push("");
    if (name) lines.push("Nome: " + name);
    if (notes) lines.push("Observações: " + notes);
    lines.push("", "Pedido feito pelo site.");
    window.open(waUrl(lines.join("\n")), "_blank", "noopener");
  });

  // "Custom Orders" no menu abre conversa de encomenda personalizada
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-wa-custom]").forEach(function (a) {
    a.href = waUrl("Olá! Gostaria de fazer uma encomenda personalizada de bolo.");
  });

  /* ============ BUSCA ============ */
  var searchBtn = $("#searchBtn"), searchbar = $("#searchbar"), searchInput = $("#searchInput");
  var scrolledToCatalog = false;
  function toggleSearch(force) {
    var open = typeof force === "boolean" ? force : searchbar.hidden;
    searchbar.hidden = !open;
    searchBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));
    if (open) searchInput.focus();
    else { searchInput.value = ""; filter(""); scrolledToCatalog = false; }
  }
  function filter(q) {
    q = q.trim().toLowerCase();
    var shown = 0;
    grid.querySelectorAll(".product").forEach(function (card) {
      var match = !q || card.getAttribute("data-search").indexOf(q) !== -1;
      card.hidden = !match;
      if (match) shown++;
    });
    $("#noResults").hidden = shown !== 0;
  }
  searchBtn.addEventListener("click", function () { toggleSearch(); });
  searchInput.addEventListener("input", function () {
    filter(searchInput.value);
    if (!scrolledToCatalog && searchInput.value) {
      scrolledToCatalog = true;
      $("#catalog").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
    }
  });

  /* ============ MENU MOBILE ============ */
  var nav = $("#nav"), menuBtn = $("#menuBtn");
  menuBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
    var open = nav.classList.toggle("open");
    menuBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));
  });
  nav.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    if (e.target.closest("a")) { nav.classList.remove("open"); menuBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false"); }
  });

  /* ============ HEADER AO ROLAR ============ */
  var header = $("#top");
  function onScroll() { header.classList.toggle("scrolled", window.scrollY > 10); }
  window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });
  onScroll();

  /* ============ SETAS DO SIGNATURE ============ */
  var sigGrid = $("#sigGrid");
  function sigScroll(dir) {
    var step = sigGrid.querySelector(".sig-item").offsetWidth + 16;
    sigGrid.scrollBy({ left: dir * step, behavior: "smooth" });
  }
  $("#sigPrev").addEventListener("click", function () { sigScroll(-1); });
  $("#sigNext").addEventListener("click", function () { sigScroll(1); });

  /* ============ TECLADO ============ */
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.key !== "Escape") return;
    if (drawer.classList.contains("open")) closeCart();
    else if (!searchbar.hidden) toggleSearch(false);
    else if (nav.classList.contains("open")) { nav.classList.remove("open"); menuBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false"); }
  });

  // Rodapé: reaproveita a logo do cabeçalho, ano atual e links de WhatsApp
  $("#footerLogo").src = $(".logo img").src;
  $("#year").textContent = new Date().getFullYear();
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-wa-hello]").forEach(function (a) {
    a.href = waUrl("Olá! Gostaria de mais informações.");
  });

  renderCart();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
